name: Vasilis Deerlington
source:
Pronouns: They/Them

A rude student who Nova eventually came across when they were drawing graffiti with Crownven. The two later meet in the library, where Nova asks if they can do their homework with them.

[spoiler]It's shortly revealed that the Headmistress is their sister, although they quickly explain that it's a "cultural thing" that Nova "wouldn't understand." They're rebellious because they don't want other students to think they have an unfair advantage over them. [/spoiler]
